name: Inversion: Inverted World
source:
What if the world you knew worked in a completely different way?

Inversion is an 18+ visual novel set in a world where the roles of men and women are completely reversed.

In this society, men are naturally smaller, gentler, and protected, while women are stronger, taller, and take on the dominant role in everyday life.

After spending more than two years in a coma, you wake up in a hospital with no memory of who you are. But losing your memory is only the beginning.

Something has changed within you. 

[From [url=https://f4elan.itch.io/inversion-inverted-world]Itch.io[/url]]
